sources.title: Suspension of Visa Issuance to Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The live State Department notice, last updated February 2, 2026, implements Presidential Proclamation 10998 and names Afghanistan in the full-suspension cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Afghanistan, Burma, Burkina Faso, Chad, Republic of the Congo

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. § 1101: Definitions
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.officialityEvidence: The official U.S. Code publishes INA section 101(a)(38), defining the geographic United States to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands and the Northern Mariana Islands.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

conflicts.explanation: PP10998 fully suspends Afghan nationals' entry and visa issuance, but valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and discretionary determinations cannot be flattened to one visitor status.
The full suspension is materially conditional and INA's geographic definition includes Puerto Rico; exceptions and valid-visa grandfathering prevent normalization.
The full suspension is materially conditional and INA's geographic definition includes Guam; exceptions and valid-visa grandfathering prevent normalization.
The full suspension is materially conditional and INA's geographic definition includes the Northern Mariana Islands; exceptions and valid-visa grandfathering prevent normalization.
The full suspension is materially conditional and INA's geographic definition includes the Virgin Islands; exceptions and valid-visa grandfathering prevent normalization.
